{{Top|leg}}
The '''Manarai Heights''' was a district on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It contained [[Eastport/Legends|Eastport]] and the [[Tannik Spaceport]], and suffered an outbreak of [[Brainworm Rot Type A]] just before the start of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Behind the scenes==
Manarai is misspelled 'Manaai' in [[James Luceno]]'s novel [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|''Darth Plagueis'']].
